bug_fixed.issue: Delete button not showing because `user` was undefined
bug_fixed.root_cause: LocationRP.js was destructuring `{ user }` from useAuth() but AuthContext provides `currentUser`
bug_fixed.fix: Changed `const { user } = useAuth()` to `const { currentUser: user } = useAuth()`
